verdict.rationale: First-party docs say on-demand deployments run on dedicated GPUs, giving predictable performance unaffected by other users and no hard rate limits compared with serverless. The deployments autoscaling docs cover scale-to-zero, and firectl provides deployment creation. missing for 10: detailed autoscaling configuration evidence (min/max replicas, scaling triggers) beyond scale-to-zero, independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation and autoscaling behavior.
